The vignettes are the manual. Each one states the biology, the gates that
decide a design, and the evidence behind them.

## Chemistries

- [KASP and allele-specific designs](markers-kasp.html) — `snp`, `indel`,
  `multi`, `duplex`, `lax`, `asq`, `primer`.
- [Gel and melt designs](markers-gel.html) — `caps`, `arms`, `hrm`, `ssr`,
  `indel_size`.
- [Probe designs](markers-probe.html) — `taqman`, `dpcr`, `snapshot`, `castpcr`.
- [Isothermal designs](markers-isothermal.html) — `lamp`, `rpa`.
- [CRISPR and Sanger sequencing](markers-crispr-sequencing.html) — `crispr`,
  `sanger`.

## Workflows

- [KASP introduction](kasp-intro.html) — the full workflow in 15 minutes.
- [Custom genome](custom-genome.html) — your own FASTA or VCF.
- [Reading results](reading-results.html) — export a solved plan, audit a
  candidate, read a rejection.

Open any of them in R with `vignette("kasp-intro")` and the rest by the names
above.
